stage_attempts.incoming_feedback: Reviewer: ["Concurrent access test (case 5) fails with OperationalError. The implementation uses threading.Lock which does not protect against concurrent processes (multiprocessing). SQLite connections need proper handling for multi-process access - the current implementation creates per-thread connections but doesn't ensure atomic claim operations across processes. The claim method uses a SELECT followed by UPDATE pattern which is not atomic across processes, leading to race conditions where multiple processes may attempt to claim the same job simultaneously, causing SQLite operational errors."]
